puzzle.hint: This verse describes the best of creation as those who believe and do righteous deeds.
puzzle.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
puzzle.verseEn: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
